failure_modes.mode: Fixture checks are mistaken for production launch evidence
failure_modes.cause: Passing tests hide missing candidate/source/ATS acceptance
failure_modes.effect: Unsupported live release or misleading verification claims
failure_modes.detection: Explicit gate matrix and source/adapter limitations
failure_modes.mitigation: Release remains blocked; no default enablement or deployment; label all actual verification fixture-only

failure_modes.mode: Migration/rollback loses history or revives unsafe authority
failure_modes.cause: Positional writes, destructive restore or older binary ignores context
failure_modes.detection: Old-schema rerun/hash rehearsal and restart/import approval negatives
failure_modes.mitigation: Additive schema, compatible contained rollback, populated restore refusal and fresh review requirements

failure_modes.mode: Original dirty user checkout is modified
failure_modes.cause: Verification uses editable install or production paths
failure_modes.detection: Explicit PYTHONPATH/temporary roots and final original-repo status comparison
failure_modes.mitigation: All implementation/testing remains in isolated feature worktree; no production startup/dependency install/commit/push
